description: Розклад руху громадського транспорту is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Горішньоплавнівська міська рада Кременчуцького району Полтавської області. The set contains data on public transport flights (resource trips); schedule of departure and arrival of transport to and from stops (stopTimes resource); options for weekly schedules of public transport (resource calendar); list of exceptions to weekly schedules (resource calendarDates). Coverage: Горішньоплавнівська міська рада Кременчуцького району Полтавської області. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport schedule" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Горішньоплавнівська міська рада Кременчуцького району Полтавської області. Its keywords include відбуття, автобус, графік, транспорт, прибуття, перевізники. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, CVS. The listing shows 2026-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
